_comment: English overrides for catalogue data, keyed by product slug. The catalogue itself is admin-editable and stores one language; rather than add locale fields to the domain model and the admin form, the `en` locale looks its copy up here and falls back to whatever the catalogue holds. A product with no entry simply shows its Japanese text.

pasta-magic-powder.name: Pasta Magic Powder
pasta-magic-powder.shortDescription: Water, salt, pasta — and one spoonful. From the home kitchen to the Italian one.
pasta-magic-powder.description: A pasta seasoning blended for aglio e olio. Dried garlic, chilli, parsley and basil come together with pasta water and olive oil for an easy, aromatic finish.
pasta-magic-powder.ingredients: Garlic flakes, minced garlic, chilli, parsley, basil, salt and chicken consommé
pasta-magic-powder.usage: For one serving, use 5g of Pasta Magic Powder with 100g of pasta. Combine with 3 tablespoons of pasta water, then finish with 15g of extra virgin olive oil.
pasta-magic-powder.storageInstructions: Seal the pouch tightly after use and store away from direct sunlight, heat and humidity. Refer to the package for the best-before date.
pasta-magic-powder.origin: Please refer to the product packaging.
pasta-magic-powder.shelfLife: Please refer to the product packaging.
pasta-magic-powder.allergenWarning: Contains chicken consommé. Please refer to the product packaging for allergen information.
pasta-magic-powder.nutritionInfo: Please refer to the product packaging.
